thread:
mara: Heads up — seeing a fairness skew after we bumped retry_window to 500ms. small tenants seem to be getting more admissions in bursts. anyone else?

devin: yep, metrics show admission_rate for small_tenants up ~18% on bursts. tail latency better overall but fairness delta increased.

sanjay: sounds like retries are being treated as fresh admissions by the lease allocator — they get retried quickly and keep getting admitted.

tess: quick idea: a transient 'recent-deny' penalty in admission decider so a tenant denied in last X ms has lowered priority for Y ms. cheap to implement as an in-memory short TTL.

mara: that helps curb hot-retry loops but could penalize small tenants recovering from transient failures. tradeoff: fairness vs availability.

devin: alternate approach: dedupe retries at the front-end (collapse retries within 100ms if same idempotency token). reduces duplicate work. but relies on clients.

sanjay: agreed dedupe is nice but not universal. we need a server-side control as safety net.

ratebot: ratebot: alert tenant-retries spike for tenant=tenantA (90s window) :warning:

mara: operational concern: if penalty is naive, clients might retry more -> more penalties -> circular hurt. need decay/backoff on penalty itself.

devin: propose: penalty score that decays exponentially (half-life 1s), capped max_penalty 5s, plus randomized jitter to avoid sync. admission decision uses base_score - penalty_score.

tess: also want to track telemetry: per-tenant retry_count_since_last_success and denial_streak. that'll let us detect pathological retry loops vs legitimate increased load.

sanjay: simulation note: we should run trace-driven sims to ensure penalty doesn't cause throughput collapse during real bursts. will simulate mix of small/large tenants with realistic retry distributions.

mara: rollout plan: feature-flagged transient penalty in admission service, enable on 10% canary hosts, collect fairness delta, p99 latency, and throughput per-tenant.

devin: I'll instrument the dashboards and add a synthetic job to replay last 24h traces against the sim harness.

tess: i'll write a short RFC patch describing config knobs: penalty_half_life_ms, max_penalty_ms, jitter_pct, expire_on_success boolean. add a canary checklist.

sanjay: small request: make penalty logic pluggable so we can iterate (dedupe, penalty, or hybrid) without big deploy churn. maybe implement as admission filter chain.

mara: +1 to filter chain. keeps boundary clean and easier for A/B.

tess: ok i'll draft RFC + small design diagram. plan to land telemetry tickets and a canary run. anyone object to admission-stage filter vs separate sidecar?

mara: prefer admission-stage — lower latency and single source of truth for admission.

devin: no objections. will help with sim and dashboards.

sanjay: fine by me. action items: tess RFC, devin sim + dashboards, mara telemetry tickets, ops to set up canary flag.

deploy-bot: deploy started: eng-infra/penalty-experiment -> canary-10%

tess: thanks — i'll ping when RFC is up for review :thumbsup:
summary: short thread discussing transient penalty vs dedupe for retry-induced fairness skew; plan: configurable admission-stage penalty, decay, jitter, sim + canary
